text:
rachel: Heads-up: Planning a coordinated partner ops run next Tue 11am PT to exercise the deprecation of the /v1/sync-batch endpoint (sunset in 30 days). Need Marketplace, Eng-Platform, Support, and 2 SI partners.
samir: I can own the runtime changes and the graceful 301->/v1/batch redirect behavior. Will put a canary org: canary-sysint-2.
neha: Partnerships will handle partner comms. Drafting: short notice + migration checklist (client changes, header updates). Will post drafts by EOD Fri.
tom-support: Support will rehearse triage flow and the quick rollback (feature-flag re-enable). Add escalation threshold: if >15% failed requests for 5m -> escalate.
marketplace-bot: export: https://redwood.internal/partners/export?org=canary-sysint-2
samir: Runtime checklist snippet:
- Enable redirect shim in staging (301 + Link header to /v1/batch)
- Emit deprecation header X-Deprecation: sync-batch-2026-04
- Metric: count of clients hitting /v1/sync-batch after redirect
- Simulate SDK v2 client sending legacy payload shape
neha: Partner comms plan items:
- Initial: canary notice to impacted partners with migration doc link
- Mid: status update during run if any persistent errors
- Post: short RCA + migration timelines and code samples
tom-support: Triage playbook: collect trace id, request sample, and SDK version. Use auto-response template if widespread.
rachel: Final asks: Samir  deploy shim to staging and paste link; Neha  post partner email + migration doc; Tom  upload escalation template.
samir: Shim deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.internal/flags/sync-batch-shim (read-only).
neha: Draft email uploaded to /partnerships/drafts/sync-batch-migration.md
tom-support: Escalation template uploaded to /support/templates/sync-batch-escalation.md. Ill be on the run.
rachel: Thanks everyone  see you Tuesday. :calendar:
